name: vpx-scorbit-plugin
$comment: Windows dependencies of the full plugin build, all of them the SDK's: the plugin fetches scorbit_sdk, which needs these. Inert on Linux and macOS, where nothing passes vcpkg's toolchain file.

Ports and builtin-baseline are copied from scorbit_sdk main's vcpkg.json. The SDK revision pinned by SCORBIT_SDK_GIT_TAG predates that file and has no manifest of its own, so the Boost ports were checked against the pinned source tree instead: every Boost header family it includes has a port here.
Re-check when SCORBIT_SDK_GIT_TAG moves. A Boost header the SDK includes but no port here provides makes the SDK fetch Boost itself, and that copy collides with vcpkg's targets.
Use triplet x64-windows-static-md, not x64-windows-static. The plugin and the SDK link the dynamic CRT.
